services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Whether you are a family or small business group, senior citizen group or a tour operator, we are happy to tailor your visit to the lighthouse with either a guided or self-guided

blurb: Guests can visit the museum to see artifacts and exhibits about lighthouses and maritime history of the Great Lakes. They can climb the lighthouse tower for a 360-degree view of Milwaukee, Lake Park, and Lake Michigan. The museum also features exhibits such as the S.S. Christopher Columbus and hosts monthly lecture series and occasional art shows.
